generationNotes: A Cloudflare human-verification screen appeared once after Scene 01 generation. No challenge was automated; after Chrome was restarted with the requested permissions, the signed-in session resumed without the gate.
Every accepted keyframe is 1792×1008 and keeps faces, gestures, lanterns, and Glow inside the centered 4:3 action-safe region.
Every accepted motion asset is a 6.041667-second 1280×720 H.264 clip at 24 fps. Runtime playback is muted; narration, score, ambience, and effects come from the authored audio stems.

states.motionPrompt: Locked camera, near-still living illustration. Ferns sway barely, Pip breathes, scarf fringe lifts once, and distant cottage windows shimmer faintly. Pip remains in place. The acorn lantern must remain completely dark and Glow must not appear. Preserve the exact composition, character anatomy, watercolor paper texture, and paper border. No camera move, no new objects, no text, no morphing; make the beginning and end compatible for a calm loop.

Locked camera. Pip gives the existing single silver thread two small careful tugs; on the second tug it releases and Glow floats free, settling beside Pip with a relieved warm hover. Ferns and scarf move subtly. Preserve the exact composition, character anatomy, thread continuity, painterly texture, and paper border. No camera move, no new objects, no text, no morphing. End on a steady resolved hold for story narration.

rejectedCandidates.reason: The wider creek frame made the rescue less intimate and the single thread less legible.
